summary: Added a /-/tasks introspection endpoint and replaced BackgroundTask.plugin with BackgroundTask.function. In datasette/background_tasks.py: removed the unused inspect import and _resolve_plugin_name, added _function_path (unwraps functools.partial, falls back to type(func).__call__, returns module.qualname), changed BackgroundTask.__init__ to take (name, func) and set self.function, simplified supervisor.add, and added a read-only launched property. In datasette/app.py: added _tasks() returning name/state/function/started_at/exception plus launched, registered the permissions-debug-gated /-/tasks route after /-/threads, and updated add_background_task's docstring to .function. In docs: internals.rst now documents .function; introspection.rst gained a /-/tasks section. Check command passed: 240 passed, 3 xpassed.
concerns: The endpoint relies on _tasks() reading self._background_tasks; verify that _tasks is defined before route registration uses it at runtime (it is, method lookup is dynamic).
Docs wording for .function is new; reviewer may want different example paths.
